## Observation
After bug 84c7 removed the four ghost rows, **all 9 remaining `KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS` rows
declare an empty prefix**. `_rebar_env: (0, "REBAR_")` was the only row that ever used the
second tuple element, and its helper was drained out of the tree by the RP-04 cutover
(`d361eb28e4`).

The prefix is still applied at `scripts/gen_env_registry.py` `_scan_call`
(`reads.setdefault(prefix + lit, ...)`) and at `scripts/check_config_ownership.py`
`_helper_access` (`return self._resolved_env(node, prefix + lit)`).

## Why it matters
The feature has **zero production users and zero live end-to-end coverage**, and its only
historical coverage passed for the wrong reason (see the 84c7 comment correction). An
unused-but-wired feature in two CI gate scripts is a maintenance hazard: it cannot rot
visibly, only silently.

## Decision (operator ruling, recorded in comments)
**Remove the prefix field from both consumers**, simplifying both tables to a bare int
(`helper name -> 0-indexed position of the env-name argument`). Rationale: no live row uses
a prefix, the 84c7-era held-out assertion is vacuous with every live prefix empty, and repo
policy prefers deleting unused code over testing an unused feature. A future prefixed
helper can re-add the field together with real coverage.

Scope:
- `scripts/gen_env_registry.py`: `KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS` becomes `dict[str, int]`; `_scan_call`
  stops applying a prefix and `_call_key_expr` reads the bare int instead of subscripting
  `[0]` on the row (the third live consumer of the tuple shape).
- `scripts/check_config_ownership.py`: `_helper_access` stops applying a prefix.
- Tests touching the tuple shape updated (`test_known_env_helper_call_resolves_and_fires`
  destructuring, the ghost-row literal in `test_gen_env_registry.py`).
- `docs/env-vars.md` regenerates byte-identical (no live row used a prefix).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The prefix field is removed from `KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS` in both consumers and the
      `prefix + lit` application code is gone from `_scan_call` and `_helper_access`.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck` and `make test` stay green.
- [ ] `docs/env-vars.md` is unchanged by the work (no live row uses a prefix).

## Provenance
Observed while fixing bug 84c7 (surprised-convincing-gopher); recorded rather than repaired
there. The remove-vs-cover design fork was escalated and resolved by operator ruling —
see comments.
